name: HARBIN MAHJONG
description: Harbin Mahjong is a regional Mahjong variant associated with Harbin and wider northeast China play. It follows the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while using local table conventions for what hands qualify and how points are assessed.

content.text: Harbin Mahjong is a regional Mahjong variant associated with Harbin and wider northeast China play. It follows the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while using local table conventions for what hands qualify and how points are assessed.
Harbin Mahjong reflects regional Mahjong table practices in northeast China, evolving from shared Mahjong foundations into a recognizable local rules profile.
Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
